accountId.description: The account the changes were applied to.

oldState.description: The SieveScript state before this set, or null if the server cannot calculate it.

newState.description: The SieveScript state after this set.

created.description: Successfully created scripts, keyed by client creation id. isActive is true when onSuccessActivateScript activated the script in the same call.

updated.description: Map of successfully updated SieveScript id to the server-side changes from every cause, or null when nothing changed server-side. Contains only changed properties: blobId after a content change, name after a null reset, isActive after activation or deactivation.

destroyed.description: SieveScript ids that were successfully destroyed.

notCreated.description: Creation ids that failed, with a SetError.

notUpdated.description: SieveScript ids that failed to update, with a SetError.

notDestroyed.description: SieveScript ids that failed to destroy, with a SetError.
